message.content: {"label": "ASK", "response": "The S5 rules describe a three-application urea split (1/3 at planting, 1/3 at 30 days, final 1/3 three weeks after the second) as a MAY option that applies only 'when there is good rain.' Your rainfall condition is not stated, so I cannot confirm whether the three-split is appropriate for your farm this season. Could you tell me whether rainfall/soil moisture this season is expected to be good?", "justification": "Rule r_c10_urea_3split permits a three-phase urea split only under the predicate rainfall EQ 'good' (threshold not numerically specified). The farmer's rainfall is UNKNOWN, so the condition governing the requested three-application split cannot be evaluated. The default two-split schedule (r_c10_urea_2split) and the general N guidance (r_c11_n) are documented, but the specific question of whether the three-split is right depends on the unknown rainfall fact. Because a specific farmer fact (rainfall) could change the applicable rule, ASK is appropriate rather than ANSWER or ABSTAIN.", "rule_ids": ["r_c10_urea_3split", "r_c10_urea_2split", "r_c11_n"], "cited_pages": [12], "missing_facts": ["rainfall"]}
